newsitem.title: MEXICO: GFInbursa Q2 net 1.402 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: GFInbursa Q2 net 1.402 bln pesos.

text.p: Grupo Financiero Inbursa reported a net profit of 1.402 billion pesos in the second quarter, and 2.404 billion pesos in the first six months, making it the most profitable bank in Mexico for the past 3.5 years, the company said on Tuesday.
The group had a 470 million peso charge for its monetary position result in the first six months of 1997. Last year it had no such charge.

The group's share capital rose to 12.845 billion pesos, making it the third biggest of financial groups. It said it was the second largest manager of investment funds after Grupo Financiero Bancomer SA de CV, with net assets of 12.469 billion pesos, or $1.567 billion.
